title: CodexCompletionReport
description: Structured completion report for a delegated tasks/current.md task. Mirrors AGENTS.md's 'Completion report' section. Pass this file to `codex exec --output-schema` so Claude can parse the result instead of re-reading free-form prose.

status.description: 'done' = task completed per Acceptance Criteria. 'stopped' = hit one of AGENTS.md's Stop conditions before finishing; see stop_reason.

stop_reason.description: Required and non-empty when status is 'stopped'. Null when status is 'done'. Which Stop condition was hit and why.

summary.description: What was implemented, in a few sentences.

command.description: Exact command run, e.g. powershell -File scripts\build.ps1

test.description: What was manually verified and how, or why it couldn't be (this project has no automated test suite — see docs/coding-rules.md).

review_points.description: Specific things Codex wants Claude to look at: deviations from the task, uncertain judgment calls, anything that felt like it needed a bigger design decision.
